newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint eases vs dlr, central bank basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint eases vs dlr, central bank basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint extended its losses against the dollar on the mark's weakness and eased slightly versus the central bank currency basket, dealers said on Monday.
"The (international) dollar/mark market was hectic," said Istvan Horvath of Hypo-Bank Hungaria. "It was hard (for the forint) to follow that."
The forint closed at 184.38/43 to the dollar, down from 183.40/45 at the opening and midday's 183.85 as the dollar firmed against the mark, deaalers said.
The differential from the central bank's resistance level (NBH bid) widened to some 30 pips amid strengthening dollar buying interest, from about 15 pips at midday.
Dealers said the dollar buying was speculative and Hungary's relatively strong economic fundamentals did not justify the easing of the forint.
"They expected the dollar to firm further (against the mark)," said Kereskedelmi Bank's Szabolcs Brezina.
Dealers said the market was nervous and many banks were cautious in dealings as the forint may drift closer to the NBH bid soon.
"The market is nervous," said Horvath. "The question is when we go back (towards the NBH bid)."
(The NBH intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
